remarks: Located on the brim of vibrant downtown Stamford and in the heart of the popular Fairgate community, this newer townhome is so accommodating! Residents enjoy a meticulously maintained, pet-friendly environment - and - BONUS - access to popular Fairgate organic Farm! Central A/C, economical gas heat, 5-star energy rated appliances And NO ADDITIONAL FEES, put this townhouse on your "must see" list! Applicants must complete the Fairgate application uploaded in supplements and credit check through Applyconnect only.
